_readme: Rerolls (6 Nov, Matt: the stages "all look exactly the same"): five stage plates that copied their site's own plate - the style image was that plate. Now another site's plate of the same zone (palette only), a clearly different spot said in words. 5 jobs x $0.15. Run with --force. Written by make_stage_plates_manifest.py (REDO).

jobs.description: A first-person view at crouching eye level, as if from behind cover in a light-gun arcade game, looking further into the overgrown allotments: plastic water butts tipped over on their sides, a puddle spread from them, sheds with their doors torn off and lying in the weeds, rows of broken bean canes, a dark open shed doorway on the left. A clearly different spot from the allotments' usual view: no polytunnel, the sheds on the left now, not the right. Nobody in the scene, empty and waiting. No people or figures anywhere. Composed for three figures to stand in later: clear open ground in the middle distance just right of centre, a dark doorway or gap on the left side well down the scene, and room in the right foreground. The ground runs across the lower third; the horizon sits a third of the way down. One continuous scene edge to edge: no repeated sections, no seams. The painting fills the whole canvas right to all four edges: no border, no frame, no margin, no empty space around it. Any signs, boards or fascias are blank, with no lettering on them. The bottom fifth of the scene is plain open ground running to the frame's edge, nothing standing in the foreground: no walls, rubble or cover there, it is drawn over later. Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image - nothing of its view, its place or its subject, which is somewhere else entirely. A crouching viewpoint, with near, middle and far ground. The painting fills the whole canvas to all four edges, no border, frame or margin. Every board, panel, screen and label in it blank, no lettering, numbers or pictures anywhere. Realistic painted pixel art, soft overcast light, muted cool northern palette, worn and lived-in, post-collapse Britain on a grey day; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not glossy; no text, no logos.
